product: agnosticui - v2 docs llm prompt guide

spans.text: The source of truth for all valid props and enums is agnosticui-schema.json.
spans.note: The prompt strongly emphasizes correctness and validation. It provides explicit schema constraints, enumerates valid enum values, shows common mistakes and why they fail validation, and directs the LLM to use the schema as the source of truth. This promotes information integrity by ensuring outputs conform to a verifiable contract.

spans.text: **Validatable at runtime:** `validateGraph()` checks every node against the Zod schema and verifies that all child ID references resolve within the graph, before any rendering occurs.
